scope: Account and feature rules documented for prospective creators, not user-specific eligibility, legal or financial advice

activity_gates.label: Create a public channel
activity_gates.outcome: Channel may upload, comment and make playlists; supported account and supervision status are separate

activity_gates.label: Publish an ordinary video
activity_gates.outcome: YouTube Studio permits eligible uploads; file, rights and internet access remain necessary

activity_gates.label: Long video and custom thumbnail
activity_gates.outcome: Phone verification enables uploads over 15 minutes and custom thumbnails

activity_gates.label: Webcam or encoder live stream
activity_gates.outcome: May need activation time; webcam/encoder methods use suitable equipment and stable connection

activity_gates.label: Mobile livestream
activity_gates.outcome: 50 subscribers required, and under 1000 subscribers mobile audience may be limited and archive private by default

activity_gates.label: Advanced feature access
activity_gates.outcome: Sufficient channel history or available ID/video verification after phone check; method availability varies

activity_gates.label: Receive native monetization payouts
activity_gates.outcome: Eligible thresholds, geography, reviews, monetization module terms and account settlement are separate; cannot infer approval from views

verification_rules.standard: Standard features are normally available after channel creation if there are no active Community Guidelines strikes.
verification_rules.intermediate: Phone verification unlocks longer videos and custom thumbnail capability.
verification_rules.advanced: Phone verification plus sufficient channel history, or eligible ID/video verification, does not guarantee immediate access to every tool.
verification_rules.live: At least age 16, channel verified, no livestream restrictions for 90 days, activation may require up to 24 hours.
verification_rules.mobile: At least 50 subscribers and compatible mobile OS; restrictions may remain until 1000 subscribers and can persist for weeks.
verification_rules.monetization: YPP review and module/location/payment eligibility independent of uploading; no earnings, minimum cash flow or mandatory creator payout assumed.

cost_categories.source_note: No paid channel-creation license or equipment purchase listed in the official setup steps; this does not establish all real costs are zero
Phone/computer already owned can have maintenance, power and depreciation
Uploads and live sessions consume connectivity; bandwidth prices depend on plan
Editing, recording, moderation and abandoned attempts require work hours
Licensed footage, images, audio or trademarks may require permission and payment
Not a universal platform prerequisite for standard eligible uploads
Monetization requires account-specific tax and payment setup but no bank information is requested for research

timelines.condition: Live streaming enabled and channel otherwise eligible; activation may take up to 24 hours
Between 50 and 999 subscribers additional audience restriction and private archive may apply
Not inferred from channel creation, subscribers, view counts or upload dates

rule_boundaries: Feature gate checks operate on hypothetical explicit booleans; absent flags are unknown, never silently false or verified true.

No mandatory paid software, advertising, camera or hardware purchase appears in official channel creation/upload instructions; this is not proof that operating a creator channel costs zero money or time.
A Google Account and a public YouTube channel are different access states.
An upload, a published video, an enabled streaming tool, approval for YPP and a cleared bank transfer are different events.
Mobile livestream subscriber and age requirements are not generic requirements for publishing ordinary videos.
Phone verification is a conditional feature gate, not a mandatory prerequisite for all standard uploads.
YPP criteria may change; do not hard-code monetary thresholds from a different effective period into a zero-budget entry claim.
